# Allowing strategies for the Market

## What is a strategy?

A Strategy is a pre-configured recipe of Credit Manager, designed to make Adapter configuration (which is one of the most complex parts of Market setup) easier.

The strategy being a transaction bundle includes:

* Target collateral token
* Adapters enabling efficient swapping routes
  * Whitelisted DEX pools
  * Vaults' integration to allow deposits/ withdrawals
* Compatibility collateral tokens&#x20;
  * Rewards tokens generated by target collateral (e.g. CRV & CVX for Convex)
  * Intermediate tokens used for complex swaps (e.g. DAI -> USDC -> USDe -> sUSDe -> PT sUSDe requires having all the tokens listed as collaterals even though they can have 0 LT and limit)
